svg.title: Black Curves
svg.desc: Schematic visual study after the cited photograph. Approximate geometry and standardized colors; wall and cast shadows omitted. Museum photograph shows bowed left edge, indented right edge and sloping upper/lower edges. Approximate flattened support; physical dimensions from exact museum object6013, not a secondary measurement.
